convert_IMAS_core_sources_to_TORAX_confi: convert an IMAS core_sources IDS into a TORAX sources configuration dictionary
extract_source_profiles_from_IMAS: extract time-dependent 1D profiles for a given source from an IMAS core_sources IDS
combine_multiple_source_profiles: combine multiple source profiles of the same type by adding their values together
load_only_external_sources_from_IMAS: load only external fuelling and heating sources from an IMAS core_sources IDS
accumulate_sources_into_TORAX_dict: accumulate extracted source profiles and convert them to a TORAX sources dict
